clamp_reaction_note: Pre-integration constraint forces at evaluation_time, paired with saved pose one timestep later. Cartesian signs checked by exact J.T multiplication. Two-point support has a redundant axial constraint: individual multipliers are solver-regularized; net wrench is more meaningful. Only humerus distal external clamps reported; no thorax-root wrench yet.
state_units: MuJoCo tangent vector: rotational components radians, slide components metres
scope: Numerical response only, not full range or accepted motion. Curve nodes move through axial/bending forces. Declared constraints transmit end reactions; original lattice, general wall/bone/self contact, lumen collapse, friction and actual spool are absent. Effective stiffness unmeasured. Independent geometry and force review required.

moving_sheath_bone_contact.scope: Actual moving scapula/humerus surfaces only. Equal opposite contact at common closest surface point; generalized forces by virtual work. No extra fixed guide. Limited cross-section interpolation and penalty force held between updates. No clavicle/thorax/hardware, sheath self contact, cable/conduit friction, lumen collapse or continuum indentation. Independent whole-wire/rigid screen still mandatory.

contact_protocol_note: Distributed external sheath forces added after scapular pads at each step. Held generalized forces between recorded updates. XML alone does not apply these forces. Bone friction is not internal cable friction.
